verdict.rationale: The evidence includes no documented control for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. "We don't log your data as standard" refers to customer data retention, not a telemetry opt-out. Self-hosted deployment for data privacy is a related deployment option, not a telemetry switch, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
